NEW SINCE LAST SCAN:
- 2026-08-28 New data stores and new actions (Preview)
  Five data stores entered Public Preview: Campfire, Clay, CourtListener, Daloopa, MSCI.
  "Search and read data from these data stores using natural language."
  Three existing data stores gained new ACTIONS:
    AirOps    - "Update knowledge base document metadata"
    Airtable  - "Create records for a table"
    Zoho Desk - "Update event"
